mapper.select: SELECT NVL(sum(tpd.INT_AMT),0) AS alSplitIntAmt, NVL(sum(tpd.CPRICE_AMT),0) AS alSplitCprice, NVL(sum(tpd.PRIN_AMT),0) AS alSplitPrinAmt, NVL(sum(tpd.TRADE_AMT),0) AS alSplitTradeAmt, NVL(sum(tdf.FEE_AMT),0) AS alSplitChannelFee, NVL(sum(sxf.FEE_AMT),0) AS alSplitProcedureAmt FROM (select TRADE_ID,PRIN_AMT,TRADE_AMT,IS_CANCEL,SPLIT_TRADE_ID,INT_AMT,CPRICE_AMT from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL union all select TRADE_ID,PRIN_AMT,TRADE_AMT,IS_CANCEL,SPLIT_TRADE_ID,INT_AMT,CPRICE_AMT from WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL)tpd LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp ON tpd.TRADE_ID = ftp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL sxf ON sxf.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID AND sxf.FEE_TYPE = 'B06' AND sxf.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE='Y' LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf ON tdf.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID AND tdf.FEE_TYPE = 'B09' AND tdf.IS_PAY_WITH_TRADE='Y' WHERE tpd.IS_CANCEL='N' and tpd.SPLIT_TRADE_ID=#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
